description: This PHP class defines the CustomerTransaction model for the Opencart admin report extension, providing methods to retrieve customer transaction data and total transaction counts with filtering options.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Model class for handling customer transaction reports within Opencart admin extension.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer transactions with optional filters for date range and customer name, ordered by total amount.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer transactions matching the provided filters.
